title: Budget mailbox read pages by encoded bytes while preserving receipt boundaries
outcome: Local and federated mailbox reads select bounded FIFO pages before issuing receipts and expose complete continuation metadata.
acceptance: Local mailbox read enforces an encoded-byte page budget in addition to the 200-message limit, before large materialization, and uses the existing mailbox reader/receipt owner.
Receipts cover exactly the returned message boundary; no skipped, acknowledged-but-omitted or reordered message, including escaped 256 KiB bodies and mixed own-message headers.
Reuse or factor the existing federation 2 MiB page-budget mechanism without changing participant authorization, cursor or retry semantics; clients accept short pages and preserve continuity.
Boundary, replay and continuation tests plus independent review and full gate pass.
